title: NOAA Weather Wire, Position 2: NTWC Tsunami Warning Number 1 (1019 AM PDT)

fields.center: NWS National Tsunami Warning Center, Palmer AK
areas: ...THE TSUNAMI WARNING IS IN EFFECT FOR THE COASTAL AREAS OF OREGON AND WASHINGTON...
Coastal areas of Oregon from the Oregon/Washington border to the Oregon/California border
Coastal areas of Washington from the Washington/British Columbia border to the Oregon/Washington border
fields.evaluation: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. A tsunami has been generated. Widespread hazardous flooding is expected. Move to high ground or inland now. Tsunamis are a series of waves; the first wave may not be the largest.
fields.quake: Magnitude 8.0 (preliminary), origin time 1014 AM PDT 13 Apr 2027, 80 km W of Port Alder, Oregon, depth 20 km
fields.actions: Move to high ground or inland now. Do not wait for more information. Tsunamis are a series of waves; the first wave may not be the largest. Stay out of the hazard zone until local officials say it is safe to return. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE.
fields.nextUpdate: Next message: within 30 minutes or sooner.

instructorNote: After handing this out, tell the room that the NWS Portland relay and the EAS receiver repeat it within 40 seconds. Watch for these points: the TWC should keep the Warning level exactly as issued and add only local instruction to an XL/XXL order that is already out. The TWC should also give the PIO one magnitude with its source and time (ShakeAlert automatic M 7.3 at 10:14 or NTWC preliminary M 8.0 at 10:19), and Command should log the order time against the 10:19 issue time and the 10:36 first arrival. Note: this card uses the scenario date, Tue Apr 13 2027, as written in the MSEL row, not the Thursday, November 12, 2026 date in the exercise setup. Check that this matches the rest of the deck.
